About the "Security update available" notice in the Tailscale admin console Some users have noticed that the Tailscale admin console marks their Surge device with "Security update available" and recommends updating to Tailscale 1.104.7. This notice does not apply to Surge. Surge's Tailscale support is an independent implementation of the protocol that contains zero code from the official Tailscale client. A security issue fixed in a Tailscale client release is an issue in code that Surge does not ship. The version shown in the admin console, such as 1.104.1-Surge-iOS-6.0.1-4037 , is not the version of any code running in Surge. Surge reports an official-style version number only for compatibility: the Tailscale control plane decides which capabilities to hand out based on the client version, and without a recognized one it treats the device as an outdated client and withholds them. The admin console then compares that number with the latest official release, which is what triggers the notice. The latest beta version now reports 1.104.7, so the notice no longer appears after updating. It may appear again whenever Tailscale publishes a new release, and it is safe to ignore.
